summary: Prenetics Global Ltd filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited Q1 2026 financial results press release. The release reports record IM8 revenue of $33.8M, up 23.1% QoQ and nearly 6x YoY, and raises full-year IM8 revenue guidance to $190-210M. It also notes full divestiture of digital asset holdings for $41.3M and appointment of Brian J. Rosin as CFO of IM8. No special-situation event is present; this is a routine earnings update with quarterly results, warrant-liability fair-value adjustments, and business guidance, not a strategic transaction, restructuring, or other catalyst.
